Contract Generator.contract:
Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::inputCard(cardid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		foundCard: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(c|c.CardID = cardid)
	precondition:
		BankCard.allInstance()->isUnique(b: BankCard|b.CardID)
	postcondition:
		if foundCard.oclIsUndefined() 
		then self.CardIDValidated = false and
		self.InputCard = null and
		result = false 
		else self.CardIDValidated = true and
		self.InputCard = foundCard and
		result = true 
		endif 
}
